newsitem.title: USA: Novell to cut 15 pct of European staff-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Novell to cut 15 pct of European staff-WSJ.

text.p: Novell Inc plans to cut about 15 percent of its European work force, representing about 50 jobs, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Thursday's electronic edition, the Journal said the cuts come amid reports that the network software company plans a 20 percent reduction in its worldwide work force of 5,800 employees.
The Journal cited Computer Reseller News in its report. The newspaper said Novell declined to comment on the European job cuts.
Novell was not immediately available for comment.
